intro: Compact and inviting, the Arctic table creates a cosy centre for conversations and shared meals. Its round top, sleek legs, and high-gloss finish make it perfect for contemporary spaces or smaller rooms.

features.title: Round tabletop for versatility
features.text: The round tabletop adds a modern aesthetic and creates a smooth, minimalist look that fits into your space effortlessly.

features.title: Stable rubberwood base
features.text: The solid rubberwood pedestal base ensures enhanced stability—ready for all your family gatherings.

features.title: High-gloss finish
features.text: Bring sophisticated simplicity to your home—a high-gloss finish adds sleek style that suits any modern interior.

features.title: Space-saving design
features.text: Compact but never compromising—this table brings refined style to even the cosiest dining rooms.

features.title: Striking colour contrast
features.text: The espresso-coloured base and white marble top create a stunning contrast, adding a stylish focal point to your dining space.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Arctic 4-Seater Rubber Wood Circular Dining Table
